text: {"name":"ble_rx_packet_process","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a received link-layer buffer by examining the payload after its 36-byte prefix, updating receive flags, and conditionally consulting connection state.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v10":"packet_payload","v11":"payload_length","v12":"payload_length"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":412,"meaning":"Byte flag that suppresses the packet pre-check when nonzero."},{"offset":440,"meaning":"Connection-state context passed to ll_get_conn_state."},{"offset":462,"meaning":"16-bit receive flags; bits 0 and 2 are updated from the pre-check result."},{"offset":472,"meaning":"Flags field whose bit 0 gates connection-state processing."}]}
